title: Vectors & Forces — every example, by concept
note: Comprehensive map of all vector and force artifacts, grouped by the problem each solves. Duplicates (multiple artifacts for the same concept) are kept on purpose. Recommended pick per concept comes from the tutorial spines. Generated by tools/build_vector_force_concept_map.py.
acts: Act I — what a vector is

Coordinate system.truth: Before a vector, a where: three axes, an origin, an agreed order (x, y, z).
Coordinate system.act: Act I — what a vector is

Vector basics.truth: A vector is a step, not a place - a direction and a length you can carry anywhere.
Vector basics.act: Act I — what a vector is

Magnitude / length.act: Act I — what a vector is

Unit vector / normalize.truth: Divide by length and every direction gets a unit twin.
Unit vector / normalize.act: Act I — what a vector is

Addition.truth: a + b is where you land if you walk a then b - tip to tail.

Subtraction.truth: b - a is the arrow of the gap, pointing from here to there.

Scaling.truth: A scalar is a volume knob for a direction - same line, new length.

Dot product.truth: the dot product is how much two directions agree — and here, agreeing is mercy

Projection / reflection.truth: projection is the part of you that lives along someone else's line

Cross product / torque.truth: the cross product is the turn left over when two directions disagree

Vector field / flow.truth: a field is force that has decided to be everywhere at once

Motion / velocity.truth: Every bubble leaves along the vector you point.

Work (F.d).truth: Only the part along the motion does work: W = F*d*cos(t).

Projectile / launch.truth: Gravity applied each frame bends a straight launch into a parabola.

Centripetal.truth: Constant acceleration toward a centre you never reach: a = v2/r.

Gravity / orbit.truth: Every mass pulls every other: F = G*m1*m2/r2.

Spring / Hooke.truth: a spring is honest — it returns exactly what it's given, which is why it keeps time

Pendulum.truth: a pendulum keeps time because the pull back is proportional to how far it's pulled

Momentum / collision.truth: momentum is motion that refuses to be destroyed, only handed on

Restitution / bounce.truth: every bounce is a tax on a fall

Lever / balance.truth: a lever trades force for distance and never gets something for nothing. *(The Calder mobile is this law, drifting — every arm balanced by real weights.)*

Wind / weather.truth: wind is air with somewhere to be; the force is in the speed, squared

Force field (zone).truth: falling isn't a property of the void; it's a property of the field over it — and the field is a vector you can turn

General force / pad.truth: A force is a vector on a mass: F = m*a.
